title: Implement MODE STREAM negotiation in transit daemon
description: The transit daemon must advertise and negotiate RFC 4644 streaming mode with peers. When a peer sends MODE STREAM, the daemon switches from IHAVE round-trip mode to CHECK/TAKETHIS pipelined mode. Advertise STREAMING capability in CAPABILITIES response. Artifact: module in usenet-ipfs-transit handling MODE STREAM handshake and mode state.
